description: This Java class defines enumerations and conversion methods for charge-related types in the Fineract project, including charge time types, applicability, calculation types, payment modes, and fee frequencies.

classes.name: ChargeEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert charge-related enum types to EnumOptionData objects for UI representation.

methods.name: chargeTimeType
methods.description: Converts an integer or ChargeTimeType to an EnumOptionData representing the charge time type.

methods.name: chargeAppliesTo
methods.description: Converts an integer or ChargeAppliesTo enum to an EnumOptionData indicating what the charge applies to.

methods.name: chargeCalculationType
methods.description: Converts an integer or ChargeCalculationType enum to an EnumOptionData for calculation type.

methods.name: chargePaymentMode
methods.description: Converts an integer or ChargePaymentMode enum to an EnumOptionData for payment mode.

methods.name: feeFrequencyType
methods.description: Converts an integer or PeriodFrequencyType enum to an EnumOptionData for fee frequency.
